inspiration: A status effect as a colour timeline: a unit's look is driven by time-keyed steps, each with an optional grey overlay and an alpha value, with smooth transitions, and the last step sticks for the spell's duration (config/battleEffects.json:2, :8, :13, :22). Keep the sticky final step; change the tint to a cold crystal tone with a rim.
Creation and status are separate systems: a summon fade-in is its own effect, not part of the colour timeline (config/battleEffects.json:35). Keep the split: spawn is an alpha ramp, status is a tint.

Five cue slots per unit: attack, defend, killed, move and wince (config/creatures/castle.json:21-27). The separate flinch cue lets a light hit read as sound without death. Keep the flinch slot; our own voice sets.

Ambient falloff by distance band: ambient volume follows a four-step table over Chebyshev distance, with the ambient ceiling set well below the effects volume (config/ambientSounds.json:4-9). Keep the banded falloff and the lower ceiling; our bands follow our fight distances.
Decor pools per biome: each terrain plus object type holds a random set of template objects, so decor varies from one data row (config/biomes.json:14).
Stat icons in a row: one small icon per stat in a PNG set (Sprites4x/stackWindow, names only). Keep one clear icon per stat for readability at a small size; change the iconography.
Short mechanic clips: seven tutorial WebM clips, one per mechanic (Mods/vcmi/Content/Video/tutorial). Keep the one-clip-per-mechanic onboarding idea; use our own footage.

briefs.label: Stone-grey status tint
briefs.why: the tint step reads at 375 wide as a silhouette change, and the sticky final state tells the player the effect is still on
briefs.keep: time-keyed steps; final state sticks for the duration
briefs.change: a cold crystal tone with a rim light instead of flat grey

briefs.label: Summon fade-in
briefs.why: units arrive by an alpha ramp rather than a pop-in, so the new unit reads without a jump
briefs.change: a ground rune glow and a dust puff instead of a plain fade

briefs.label: Five-slot unit voice
briefs.why: a flinch cue separate from death lets a light hit read as sound
briefs.keep: a wince slot for light hits
briefs.change: our own voice sets per unit type, with pitch and variant choice

briefs.label: Distance-banded ambience
briefs.why: a short distance table keeps ambience from fighting the effects
briefs.keep: four-step banded falloff; ceiling below effects
briefs.change: bands tied to our camera and fight distance

briefs.label: Decor pools per biome
briefs.why: random picks from a small pool per biome give variety from one data row
briefs.change: our own props and biome names
